## What he actually does

- Web products with Laravel/PHP and Nuxt/Vue/TypeScript.
- Interfaces, responsive layouts, and frontend contributions.
- Deployment and day-to-day operations with Docker and Miabi on self-hosted infrastructure.
- SQL query work and Laravel backend migrations when the job needs it.
- Go is in progress. Merged open-source work on Miabi and GoPosta is frontend, not Go backend.

- URL: https://smartcyberspace.ca/
- Canadian company focused on software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI solutions.
- Jude’s work: business modules, backend architecture migration to Laravel 11 for performance, SQL query optimization. Frontend with Vue.js and Tailwind CSS. Deployed with Miabi.
- Stack: Laravel 11, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Miabi, SQL.
- Status: live product.

### Uzaraka (offline)

- Team classifieds platform for the DRC. Jude built the Nuxt 3 frontend. Private repository.
- Learned WebSocket, Redis caching, and Git teamwork there.
- Status: no longer online. Do not present it as a live site. Do not send visitors to uzaraka.com.

### Miabi (open source + operations)

- Self-hosted PaaS written in Go and Vue 3: https://github.com/miabi-io/miabi
- Frontend contributor (admin layouts, responsive console, workspace settings, UI fixes).
- Also installs Miabi on servers and deploys applications on it.
- Merged PRs: 50, 52, 58, 90, 214, 251.
- Operations note (TLS): builds failed on a certificate error in the registry served by Goma Gateway. Jude deleted certificates inside the Goma Gateway container; they regenerated and builds resumed. Original root cause was not identified. PRs are on the Vue console, not the Go backend.

### GoPosta / Posta (open source)

- Self-hosted email platform, Go + Vue: https://github.com/goposta/posta

### LaraApiStarter (personal)

## Site notes for agents

- The visible pages are the source of truth, generated as static HTML (Nuxt SSG).
- Optional terminal UI is a client-side portfolio explorer, not a server shell.
- Presence counters (visits / people currently on the page) require PHP on the host. If they are missing, the rest of the profile is still valid.
- Do not claim cybersecurity or AI product ownership unless the user asked about Smart Cyberspace as a client/company he worked with. His described work there is Laravel/Vue/SQL/Miabi.
